# WildFly High Availability Guide

> Clustering, session replication, load balancing, and failover for WildFly — JGroups, Infinispan, mod_cluster, and HA singleton services.

## Overview

- [Introduction to High Availability Services](Introduction_To_High_Availability_Services.adoc): Overview of HA concepts in WildFly
- [Clustering and Domain Setup Walkthrough](Clustering_and_Domain_Setup_Walkthrough.adoc): Step-by-step guide to setting up a WildFly cluster
- [Clustering API](Clustering_API.adoc): Programmatic access to clustering services

## Distributable Applications

- [Distributable Web Applications](Distributable_Web_Applications.adoc): HTTP session replication and passivation for web apps
- [Distributable Jakarta Enterprise Beans](Distributable_Jakarta_Enterprise_Beans_Applications.adoc): Stateful session bean replication

## JGroups

- [JGroups](JGroups.adoc): JGroups overview — group communication for clustering
- [JGroups Subsystem](jgroups/JGroups_Subsystem.adoc): JGroups subsystem configuration — stacks, protocols, transport
- [Discovery for Kubernetes](jgroups/Kubernetes.adoc): Kubernetes-based JGroups discovery (KUBE_PING)
- [Discovery for AWS EC2](jgroups/AWS-Discovery.adoc): AWS-based JGroups discovery (S3_PING)
- [SSL/TLS Secured Transport](jgroups/SSL-TLS-Secured-Transport.adoc): Encrypting JGroups TCP transport with SSL/TLS
- [Adding External Protocols](jgroups/External_Protocols.adoc): Adding custom JGroups protocols from external modules

## Infinispan

- [Infinispan](Infinispan.adoc): Infinispan overview — distributed caching and data grids
- [Infinispan Subsystem](infinispan/Infinispan_Subsystem.adoc): Infinispan subsystem configuration — cache containers, caches, stores

## Load Balancing

- [Load Balancing](Load_Balancing.adoc): Overview of load balancing options
- [mod_cluster Subsystem](load-balancing/mod_cluster_Subsystem.adoc): Dynamic load balancing with mod_cluster
- [Affinity Cookie](load-balancing/Affinity_Cookie.adoc): Load balancer affinity via cookies
- [Ranked Affinity](load-balancing/Ranked_Affinity.adoc): Ranked session affinity for load balancers
- [SSL Configuration using Elytron](load-balancing/SSL_Configuration_using_Elytron_Subsystem.adoc): SSL/TLS configuration for mod_cluster with Elytron

## HA Singleton Features

- [HA Singleton Features](HA_Singleton_Features.adoc): Overview of HA singleton capabilities
- [Singleton Deployments](ha-singleton-features/Singleton_deployments.adoc): Deploying an application as a cluster-wide singleton
- [Singleton MSC Services](ha-singleton-features/Singleton_MSC_services.adoc): Creating singleton MSC services
- [Singleton Subsystem](ha-singleton-features/Singleton_subsystem.adoc): Singleton subsystem configuration
